Tell your family GTA 6 got cheaper, but not the 100 dollar one.

voz_guion.voz: Who in your family says everything costs more now, like GTA 6?
In 2013, GTA 5 cost 60 dollars. GTA 6 comes out November 19 at 80.
In today's money, that 60 dollars? About 86.
So you pay about 6 dollars less than a 2013 buyer.
But the 100 dollar Ultimate Edition costs you 14 more.
Tell your family GTA 6 got cheaper, but not the 100 dollar one.
